General Update - Overhauled the tooltips of many talents like Earth and Moon, Improved Moonkin Form, Playing With Fire, Celestial Bane, etc. To a new standardized format. More talents will be improved to this new format to improve readability and user-friendly understanding of the talent.

Improved Insect Swarm is now called Celestial Bane and has a new icon to match it. It no longer increases the damage of Insect Swarm directly. The base damage of Insect Swarm and scaling has been increased by 12% resulting in a buff with and without the talent.
Overhauled the Inspect UI. You can now view other player's current mystic enchants.
Heirlooms have been consolidated into just 1 version. There is now only prestigious heirlooms. All heirlooms have been upgraded to this version.

Adjusted item levels of items on Mythic, Heroic and Ascended difficulties to more closely round its item level to the amount of power gained. This will result in the changed item level of some items in these difficulties.
Fixed an issue where Bloodforged Gear was soublound after the update.
All of these apply to default nameplates and elvui nameplates
You can set nameplates to fade out based on the targets distance from your character.
Targets that you don't have line of sight with will now fade out their nameplate. This is configurable in interface settings. Your target will still cause all other nameplates to be faded out
Nameplates now layer based on your characters distance from the target. Nameplates for targets closer to your character will always show on top of others. Your target will still always be on top.
As a result of the Trial UI Overhaul: Introduced a new hyperlink feature on trial descriptions, clicking objectives will now take you directly to AscesnsionDB for more information on it.
Every trial with a level completion requirement will now lock your level until the objective is completed. (You cannot out level your trial objective and fail anymore)

Changelog Clarification: Previously above we mention that all dungeons scale, but to clarify it even further: All dungeons scale from levels 15 to 59. You can queue at level 15 to 59 and get into Scholomance Lower as an example for big juicy boss exp. This also means you are no longer 3x more likely to get Wailing Caverns while levelling compared to other dungeons. Your dungeon options while levelling are vastly increased and you can get the gear you know and love for the level you currently are.
Buffing your party member will ALSO buff your party members.
This means you can still buff people and friends you find in the open world.
All Buffs that casted on allies will now simultaneously buff your party, essentially making them an AoE buff available at low levels with the intent to save you from carpal tunnel and boredom.

All Paladin Buffs are no longer spell grouped  limiting you to only choosing one to apply per person. You  can apply multiple Paladin Buffs. This just simply wasn’t needed as you could just pick other things that had the exact same effect like Battle Shout for Blessing of Might.
Curse of the Elements can now be used in Shapeshift Forms. Demon Skin and Demon Armor can now be applied in Shapeshift Forms.

Dual Wield Specialization no longer has the capstone of: "Your off-hand attacks deal full damage.". Instead, the off-hand damage increase is now ranked and now states exactly what it does, increasing the damage of your Off-Hand attacks by 7/14/20/26/33%. This was just flipped, the previous hit or crit are now on the capstone.
Searing Totem no longer has a cooldown in any content but 1v1 content, because it doesn’t make sense to nerf a base ability for an issue that is only happening in 1v1 arena.

Windfury Weapon can now trigger During Bladestorm and Killing Spree and your other attacks during the duration of Killing Spree and Bladestorm can also trigger Windfury Weapon, previously during the duration of Both Killing Spree and Bladestorm you could not trigger Windfury Weapon with ANY attack. But it now deals 50% reduced damage to players during Killing Spree and Bladestorm (This will be monitored, but it previously could not trigger during these abilities, still making this a really big buff)
Windfury Weapon no longer deals reduced damage with Two-Handed Weapons. Since Titan's Grip already reduced all damage dealt with a slower swing time, this redundancy probably wasn't needed.

The ICD reduction from Wind Rager is now gone as it is just baked into the original ability, where it belonged in the first place, because Legendary enchants shouldn’t be a pre-requisite to having strong abilities you can use.
Windfury Weapon now has an internal cooldown of 2 seconds, from 3.5.
The capstone bonus from Iron Will has been made baseline. Mocking Blow now grants its damage reduction baseline when simply wielding a singular weapon.
Tactical Mastery now increases the damage of Devastate with a 2-handed weapon by 8/16/25%.
Devastate now deals 80% of the total damage when wielding a 2-handed weapon, because of it no longer having a requirement. This power has been baked into Tactical Mastery for 2-Handed Tanks.
Devastate no longer requires any stance to use.
